summary: Full e2e testing of C.S. Singhi & Associates portfolio site. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases pass (root, contact CRUD, careers CRUD, validation). Frontend: 39/40 functional UI checks pass (hero, nav, search overlay with Cmd/Ctrl+K, section navigation, about values & probono, services 01-06, projects horizontal rail + Sky Gangtok drawer open/close, team principal/architect/grid, careers mailto links, contact form submit + validation, footer, responsive 768px mobile menu). One minor UX nuance: about-stats counters (25, 12+, 3, 100%) animate correctly on natural wheel scroll but do NOT animate when section is reached via Lenis scrollTo (hero-nav anchor click) — they stay at 0/0+/0/0%. Not a blocker, real users wheel-scroll naturally, but worth noting.

integration_issues.issue: GSAP ScrollTrigger for the .stat__value counters does not fire when the About section is reached via Lenis scrollTo (hero-nav-about / mobile-nav-about anchor click). Counters remain at 0/0+/0/0%. On natural wheel scroll they animate correctly to 25/12+/3/100%. Likely fix: call ScrollTrigger.update() / ScrollTrigger.refresh() inside the Lenis raf loop, or add lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update) in useLenis.js so ScrollTrigger stays in sync with Lenis virtual scroll position.

action_items: (Optional / minor) Wire Lenis scroll into GSAP ScrollTrigger so .stat__value counters animate when section is reached via in-page nav click. Suggested: in useLenis.js, add `lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update)` and call `gsap.ticker.add((time)=>lenis.raf(time*1000)); gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0);`.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is referenced inside route handlers (line 80, 99) but `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` is defined further down at line 127 — this works at request time only because routes are called lazily, but it is fragile. Move logging.basicConfig + logger definition above the route handlers.
server.py: @app.on_event("shutdown") is deprecated in newer FastAPI versions; consider migrating to lifespan context manager.

About.jsx counter logic uses GSAP ScrollTrigger but the site uses Lenis smooth scroll — without ScrollTrigger.update bound to lenis.on('scroll'), animations driven by ScrollTrigger may not fire after a programmatic Lenis scroll. Already observed for stat counters.
Mongo documents store created_at as ISO string then code re-parses to datetime on list — fine, but inconsistent storage type; consider storing as native BSON datetime via motor.

rca of the issue: About counters issue RCA: GSAP ScrollTrigger reads native window scroll position via scroll events. Lenis hijacks scrolling and translates content with CSS transform while keeping native scroll mostly static. When user clicks an in-page anchor, Lenis animates the transform/scroll; GSAP's scroll events may not arrive on the trigger element so ScrollTrigger never fires its onEnter. Fix: subscribe ScrollTrigger.update to lenis 'scroll' event and run lenis.raf inside gsap.ticker (standard Lenis+GSAP integration pattern).
